authority: apostila-cga-2026; exhaustive sweep of every `até` occurrence
method: all 27 occurrences read one by one immediately after the operator batch introduced the form
reason: `até` was registered as an at-most marker in batch 13 and is wrong in 22 of its 27 occurrences. Caught by the same exhaustive sweep the campaign uses, before shipping — a bare common function word needs the sweep exactly as much as a bare common noun does.

operations.why: 22 of 27 wrong (81%). Portuguese `até` is `until` in 10 (`até o vencimento`, `até o último dia`), `even` in 5 (`até mesmo alavancar`), directional `to` in 3 (`a distância de cada ponto até a média`) and `so far` in 4 (`até agora`). It is the at-most sense only when a number follows immediately, which no lexical form can express. Removed rather than demoted: a review claim would still suppress temporal.until on the same surface.
Six occurrences, all the ceiling sense — `prazo máximo de conversão`, `limite máximo de`.
The registered `até que` occurs zero times. These four collocations carry the until sense unambiguously and leave the `even`/`so far`/directional readings alone.
